title: Reaction precedents extend retrosynthetic prediction beyond training coverage
abstract: arXiv:2610.40249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reaction precedents guide retrosynthesis, but how far they can compensate for gaps in task-specific training coverage remains unclear. Using 2.71 million reactions, we restricted training and retrieval coverage by transformation or time, then expanded only the retrieval corpus with model parameters fixed. For transformations excluded from training, mean Top-1 accuracy increased from 13.0% to 58.0% on a historical test set and from 4.9% to 23.1% on a temporally held-out test set. For temporal coverage gaps, retrieval expansion enabled a model trained on records before 2017 to match or exceed a non-retrieval model trained on records before 2025 on both test sets. Without task-specific fine-tuning, precedents improved all 14 representative general-purpose models on both test sets and USPTO-50K; the strongest with precedents surpassed all eight representative specialized models. translated_title: 反应先例使逆合成预测超越训练覆盖范围
translated_abstract: 反应先例可以指导逆合成分析，但它们能在多大程度上弥补任务特定训练覆盖范围的空白仍不清楚。基于271万条反应数据，我们通过转化类型或时间限制训练与检索的覆盖范围，然后在模型参数固定的情况下仅扩展检索语料库。对于训练中未包含的转化类型，在历史测试集上平均Top-1准确率从13.0%提升至58.0%，在时间保留测试集上从4.9%提升至23.1%。对于时间覆盖差距，检索扩展使仅用2017年之前记录训练的模型在两个测试集上能够匹敌甚至超越用2025年之前记录训练的非检索模型。在无需任务特定微调的情况下，反应先例提升了全部14个代表性通用模型在两个测试集和USPTO-50K上的表现；结合先例后最强的模型超越了全部八个代表性专用模型。这些发现表明，推理阶段的反应先例能够
tldr: 该研究证明，在模型参数固定、无需微调的情况下，仅通过在推理阶段扩展反应先例检索库，就能大幅弥补逆合成模型在训练覆盖之外的转化类型与时间差距，使通用模型性能显著提升甚至超越专用模型。
en_tdlr: By expanding only the reaction-precedent retrieval corpus at inference time with model parameters fixed, retrosynthetic models can largely compensate for gaps in training coverage—both across transformation types and over time—enabling general-purpose models without fine-tuning to match or surpass specialized ones.
